name: Garage
long_description:
Trusted by local governments and essential services businesses across America, Garage is the AI-powered marketplace transforming how America's mission-critical assets are bought and sold. By automating everything from appraisals to freight, Garage saves time and money for communities of all sizes.

We've raised $60M to date, and are backed by Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, Invus Opportunities, FJ Labs, and other leading investors.
